method: Manual source-origin audit against the manifests and configs actually collected. External reputation was not used as ground truth.

frameworks.caveat: Five sampled profiles still have partial collection, so this does not claim recall for files omitted by budget.

tooling.caveat: Lockfiles were not accepted as primary evidence. packageManager declarations and unambiguous configs were accepted.

contextualSources.policy: fixtures are excluded; docs, examples, demos, playgrounds and templates are weighted at 0.5 rather than counted as independent repositories
